company.name: Aligned Surveyors
company.description: An engineering Surveying Consultancy firm established in 2017, providing solutions in spatial and infrastructure development for property developers, planners, architects, civil engineers, and mines.

benefits.title: Established Expertise
benefits.description: Founded in 2017, we bring years of specialized experience in engineering surveying and spatial infrastructure development.

benefits.title: Professional Consultancy
benefits.description: We provide expert advice and solutions tailored to property developers, architects, and civil engineers.

benefits.title: Cost-Effective Solutions
benefits.description: Our focus is on client satisfaction by delivering high-quality, cost-effective, and timeous results for every project.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Capability
benefits.description: Equipped for everything from Topographical and Mine surveys to complex road and sewer engineering.

benefits.title: Proven Track Record
benefits.description: We have an established history of successful project delivery with major industry partners like IDBZ and Zimplats.

services.title: Topographical Surveys
services.description: Using photogrammetry via orthophoto maps, total stations, and differential GPS.
details: Photogrammetry modeling via precision drone or orthophoto arrays.
High-accuracy point tracking with Total Stations & Differential GPS networks.
Benchmark validation and foundational control layouts.

services.title: Engineering Surveys
services.description: Control at construction sites and monitoring structures for deformations.
details: Precision construction-grade engineering control grid placements.
Structural deformation, lean, and down-axis displacement monitoring.
3D mapping profiles for dump sites, structural dam surfaces, and road basins.
projects: Zimplats South Pit 2 Aerial Control Rehabilitation

services.title: Tailings Storage Facility Construction Monitoring
services.description: High-precision volumetric profiling, structural deformation checks, and penstock layout arrays.
details: Comprehensive slimes dam dimension setting out and containment monitoring.
Volumetric earthwork estimations and extraction calculation modeling.
Penstock verticality alignment tracking and deep pipe/drain construction maps.
projects: Mimosa TSF4 Dam Expansion & Penstock Alignment Tracking

services.title: Beacon Relocation or Reestablishment
services.description: Resolving property lines and mapping boundaries clearly ahead of civil development layout execution.
details: Property boundaries identification before initial development investments.
Cadastral validation to settle land encroachments or parcel disputes.
Replacement of degraded boundary nodes matching legacy title registry archives.

services.title: Sewer, Road and Water Surveys
services.description: Route surveys and setting out infrastructure networks for residential developments and city pipelines.
details: Route profiling maps for complex roads, railway tracks, or electrical main grids.
Subsurface wastewater drainage network alignments and gradient mapping.
As-built civil layout setting out checks.

services.title: Mine Surveys
services.description: Pegging of claims, coordinate collection, and drawing of mine plans.
details: Cadastral boundary pegging of mining concessions and mineral asset claims.
Coordinate mapping aligned with Ministry of Mines new digital cadastre systems.
Detailed underground and open-pit operational mining layout maps.
